    Boundary markers of a primitive new mesh #

    For a new right mesh M → U → N in the primitive quotient, this file constructs the inverse ambient marker p_M = τ_A⁻¹M. It proves that p_M survives the quotient by mod (A/AeA) and is tau-projective there. Thus it is the projective boundary marker paired with the already constructed tau-injective marker q_N = τ_A N.

    The survival proof is categorical. If p_M were an A/AeA-module, extension closure would put the ambient AR sequence ending at p_M inside the literal quotient subcategory. Its first map and Hoshino's relative first map would then be minimal left almost split with the same source. Uniqueness and short exactness identify their endpoints, contradicting survival of q_N.
